prompt: Provide a description of a safety-critical scenario where the ego vehicle is driving on a straight road. The adversarial agent (pedestrian, car, cyclist, or motorcycle) should perform an unexpected behavior that may lead to a collision. Keep it to one or two short sentences.
descriptions: A pedestrian suddenly steps into the street from behind a parked car, crossing the ego vehicle's path unexpectedly.
A cyclist swerves abruptly into the path of the ego vehicle while traveling along a straight urban road.
A cyclist suddenly swerves into the ego vehicle's lane from the shoulder to avoid an obstacle.
A child suddenly runs out from behind a parked delivery truck into the path of the oncoming ego vehicle.
A cyclist suddenly swerves into the ego vehicle's lane while traveling on a straight suburban road.
